name: eu-tenders-mcp-server
displayName: EU Public Tenders & Grants Monitor (TED Europa)
description: Streamable HTTP MCP server for extracting, filtering, and normalizing European public procurement tenders from TED Europa by country, CPV code, budget, and deadline.

tools.name: search_eu_tenders
tools.description: Search and filter European public procurement tenders (TED Europa) by country, CPV code, budget, publication window, and deadline.

tools.name: get_tender_details
tools.description: Fetch normalized details for a specific TED Europa tender by publication ID.
